newsitem.title: GERMANY: German June TV ratings in key ad target groups.
newsitem.headline: German June TV ratings in key ad target groups.

text.p: Germany's top television channel RTL lost ground in June to the ProSieben network, media marketing company IP Deutschland said on Wednesday.
RTL saw a drop in ratings to a 15.9 percent viewer share, down from 17 percent in May, IP said.
Among the key target group of the advertising industry -- 14 to 49 year-olds -- RTL also posted losses, sinking to a 18.3 percent viewer share in June from 19.6 percent in the previous month.

ProSieben Media AGK, which had a high-profile bourse debut at the beginning of July, reached a 13.5 percent share of all viewers with its two channels, Pro Sieben and Kabel 1. The share marked a 0.4 percentage point rise from May.
Among 14 to 49 year-olds, the group captured a 19.8 percent share, up from 18.6 percent in the previous month.

Despite its drop in ratings, RTL remained in first place, public broadcaster ARD moved into second with a 14.9 percent share (13.7), pushing private channel Sat1 to third in the rankings with 13 percent (14.4).
